notes.title: ADD SAVE&LOAD/LIGHT MAP FUNCTION
notes.content:
After seeing player reviews, two new features have been added

1. Added archiving system
Provide 3 archive slots
Click the save button to save the current game progress, and click the load button to load the saved progress
Clicking the save button will overwrite the current save slot gameplay progress, please note
Archive storage location: User/AppData/MingLow/XuanWuStudio/MagicPowerReset. If not accurate, you can search the XuanWuStudio folder to find the archive
   
2. Added the function of illuminating the entire image
In the early stages of the game, due to the lack of guidance, players were unable to obtain swords and therefore could not use the sword's lighting function, resulting in the inability to see the road and causing a bad gaming experience. We deeply apologize for this inconvenience
Now you can click the "Light Up Full Map" button on the menu interface to illuminate the entire map. No matter which layer you are on, you can see the distribution of monsters

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216834/0491a828a21f93eaa75eb4096d76fef92c635bbd.png[/img]

Thank you very much for your purchase and gameplay. If you find any bugs or dissatisfaction, please feel free to provide improvement suggestions
Wishing you a happy life
